svg.text: PIR-L and PIR-R on the breadboard — 3 × 2.2 kΩ pull-up per PIR
Rows 15–26 of the board · module wires in column a · ESP32 wires in column e
Same circuit as a schematic (one PIR)
2.2 + 2.2 + 2.2 = 6.6 kΩ in total. PIR connected: the PIR drives the pin LOW or HIGH.
PIR unplugged: the resistors hold the pin HIGH, so the code reports "STUCK" (a fault, not an intrusion).
